facts.fact: ICT Principal Secretary John Tanui said on 18 October 2026 that a 17,000-kilometre fibre connection project with the Communications Authority, ICT Authority and Kenya Power, to link all public institutions, is currently underway.

systems.owner: State Department for ICT with CA, ICTA and Kenya Power

KEN.note: Only says submarine cable connectivity is optimised; no route or landing stated.
Nothing on government staff running or building systems.
Public institutions, schools and chiefs' offices are named; no county or local government office is said to be connected.
